scenes.dialogue: Hi, I am Ravishankar from LawWorld. Once leave to defend is filed in an eviction case, can the tenant add fresh documents under Section One Fifty One?
scenes.shown: Hi, I am Ravishankar from LawWorld. Once leave to defend is filed in an eviction case, can the tenant add fresh documents under Section 151?

scenes.dialogue: On twenty seventh October, twenty twenty six, the Delhi High Court, through a single bench of Honourable Justice Ajay Digpaul, answered that question.
scenes.shown: On 27 October 2026, the Delhi High Court, through a single bench of Honourable Justice Ajay Digpaul, answered that question.

scenes.dialogue: The landlords sought to evict the tenants from a Chandni Chowk shop, for their bona fide need, under the summary procedure of Section Twenty Five B.
scenes.shown: The landlords sought to evict the tenants from a Chandni Chowk shop, for their bona fide need, under the summary procedure of Section 25-B.

scenes.dialogue: Nearly a year after seeking leave to defend, with arguments due, the tenants applied under Section One Fifty One of the C P C to add documents.
scenes.shown: Nearly a year after seeking leave to defend, with arguments due, the tenants applied under Section 151 of the CPC to add documents.

scenes.dialogue: Their material: the landlords' other eviction cases in the same premises, several withdrawn or disposed of, and photos of shop for rent banners.
scenes.shown: Their material: the landlords' other eviction cases in the same premises, several withdrawn or disposed of, and photos of shop-for-rent banners.

scenes.dialogue: The Additional Rent Controller dismissed it. Under Article Two Twenty Seven, the tenants said this material undercut the landlords' bona fide need.
scenes.shown: The Additional Rent Controller dismissed it. Under Article 227, the tenants said this material undercut the landlords' bona fide need.

scenes.dialogue: The High Court found the other cases were disclosed in the eviction petition. And not one shred of proof showed the landlords meant to let out the other shops.
Even if they did, Section Nineteen of the Act protects evicted tenants. And under Gaya Prasad, later events must completely eclipse the need. These did not.
scenes.shown: Even if they did, Section 19 of the Act protects evicted tenants. And under Gaya Prasad, later events must completely eclipse the need. These did not.

scenes.dialogue: The Court called it a dilatory tactic. Section One Fifty One cannot bypass Section Twenty Five B to give successive chances. The petition was dismissed.
scenes.shown: The Court called it a dilatory tactic. Section 151 cannot bypass Section 25-B to give successive chances. The petition was dismissed.
